"""
@brief Returns the Object Browser item list for a single asset type (one type per call), as a JSON string.
The asset type is given by objectBrowserContextOptions.type; supported values are OB_TYPE_FABRIC,
OB_TYPE_GRAPHIC, OB_TYPE_BUTTON, OB_TYPE_BUTTON_HOLE, OB_TYPE_TRIM, OB_TYPE_PUCKERING, OB_TYPE_ZIPPER, OB_TYPE_TOPSTITCH. The two filters are
independent: showAllColorways (tri-state) scopes the "used" check - -1 (default) follows the app's UI
"Show All Colorways" toggle, 0 forces the single colorway (colorwayIndex), 1 forces all colorways - and
bIncludeUnusedObjects additionally keeps free/unused objects (not used by any colorway) when true.
folderName is FABRIC-only: it scopes the result to one Object Browser folder. Empty = the primary/root
folder; a non-empty name = that folder (an unknown name yields an empty list). It composes with the
colorway filters and with bIncludePrints.
bIncludePrints is FABRIC-only: when true the fabric response carries print info per fabric (see @return).
@return JSON object string: { "ObjectType": "<type>", "ObjectNameList": ["name", ...] }. An unsupported
targetObjectType yields { "ObjectType": "", "ObjectNameList": [] }; an empty list is returned as [].
FABRIC with bIncludePrints == true keeps the SAME top-level "ObjectNameList" key, but its entries are
objects instead of plain names: { "ObjectType": "Fabric Prints", "ObjectNameList": [ { "Name": "<fabric>" [, "PrintName": "<print>"] }, ... ] };
the "PrintName" key is present only for fabrics that actually have a print.
"""
